summary: Iteration 3 regression testing of Belt-Sentinel. Re-ran/expanded the pytest suite (18 cases) at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and re-verified the unauthenticated frontend auth flow with Playwright. The iteration-2 CRITICAL bug (PostgREST 1000-row cap causing 60D=90D and stale/oldest data) is CONFIRMED FIXED: pagination now returns 1875 raw rows for a 90d window, all windows end at the newest timestamp (2026-09-04), and 30/60/90 have distinct first timestamps. 17/18 backend tests pass; the single failure is a downsampling off-by-stride overshoot (passport trend_90d returns 469 points instead of the documented <=400). Frontend: 9/9 unauthenticated checks pass, label-contrast fix verified in computed styles. Authenticated dashboard/HistoricalTrend/Sidebar still NOT tested (no confirmed Supabase user).

minor.issue: _downsample() overshoots its target because stride = len//target is floored: trend_full_count=1875 -> stride 4 -> 469 points returned, violating the stated <=400 contract (test TestPassport::test_passport_j2 fails on this only). Same math makes /api/history/all-joints return 303 (60d) and 313 (90d) points against a 300 target. Fix: stride = ceil(len/target) (or math.ceil-based) so the cap is a hard cap.

rows[::stride] never guarantees the LAST element is included, so the downsampled chart can end up to stride*interval (~8h) before the true latest reading. Observed: all-joints last ts = 2026-09-04T10:20 (60d) / 11:20 (90d) / 12:20 (30d) while the actual latest row is 2026-09-04T13:20. Always append rows[-1] after striding.

Seeded joint_history only spans 2026-06-18 -> 2026-09-04 (~78 days), so the 90D window is data-limited: 90d first_ts is only ~15 days earlier than 60d, and days=90 and days=120 return byte-identical series. Functionally correct (query is right) but the '90D' label over-promises; consider seeding a full 100+ days or labelling the max window as 'ALL'.

issues: Iteration-2 contrast fix VERIFIED: EMAIL/PASSWORD labels are now rgb(160,160,160) @11px and the 'PS-26008 · CLASSIFIED' badge rgb(160,160,160) @10px - both now clear WCAG AA against the #121416/#1A1C1E card. No remaining contrast blockers.
Minor: 10-11px uppercase letter-spaced text is still small for an HMI; 12px would read better on a control-room display. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Fix _downsample() stride math to use ceil so passport trend_90d is <=400 and all-joints is <=300 (currently 469 / 313).
Append the final raw row after striding so the chart always terminates at the true latest timestamp (currently up to ~8h short).
Optional: extend seed coverage past 90 days (or rename the max toggle) because days=90 and days=120 now return identical data.
Create a confirmed Supabase test user and update /app/memory/test_credentials.md so the authenticated Dashboard / HistoricalTrend 30-60-90 toggle / Sidebar can finally be UI-tested end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: supabase_client.select(paginate=True): the loop is correct but issues serial requests; a 90d window = 2 round-trips per joint x 4 joints. asyncio.gather over joints is already in place, good. Consider passing count='exact' once and pre-sizing to avoid the extra probe page.

server.py history endpoints hardcode limit=4000 as an upper bound; once joint_history grows this silently truncates again. Derive the bound from days*expected_samples_per_day or return a 'truncated: true' flag.
supabase_client.py still exports module-level SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_KEY snapshotted at import time alongside lazy _url()/_key() - two sources of truth (carried over from iteration 2, unfixed).

history_all() swallows SupabaseError per joint and returns an empty list, so a partial upstream failure renders as a silently empty chart with HTTP 200. Return a per-joint error marker so the UI can show trend-error.
POST /api/admin/seed is only gated when SEED_ADMIN_TOKEN is set; SEED_ADMIN_TOKEN is not present in backend/.env, so the endpoint (including force=true) is still publicly callable in this deployment.
seed_data_creation: None. POST /api/admin/seed correctly returned 'skipped' for sensor_status, joint_history and conveyor_telemetry (idempotent).
test_credentials: Still no usable Supabase login; /app/memory/test_credentials.md only documents manual steps (email confirmation ON, provider rate-limited). All authenticated frontend tests skipped as instructed.

Verified numbers as of 2026-09-01: history/joint J2 90d = 1875 rows asc, 2026-06-18T11:20 -> 2026-09-04T13:20; all-joints 30d=265 pts/joint (from 2026-08-02), 60d=303 (from 2026-07-03), 90d=313 (from 2026-06-18); passport trend_full_count=1875, trend_90d=469. rca_of_the_issue: Iteration-2 root cause (PostgREST db-max-rows=1000 truncating ascending-ordered queries so the newest data was dropped and 60D==90D) is resolved: supabase_client.select(paginate=True) now walks the result set with limit/offset pages and server.py queries order=timestamp.desc then reverses, so the newest rows are always fetched first and pagination fills the rest. Remaining defect is purely arithmetic: _downsample() computes stride = len(rows)//target (floor), so the output length is ceil(len/stride) which can exceed target by up to ~25% (1875 rows, target 400 -> stride 4 -> 469), and rows[::stride] omits the final row unless (len-1) % stride == 0, truncating the series a few hours short of the true latest timestamp. Reproduce: GET /api/joint/passport?joint_id=J2 -> len(trend_90d)==469 with trend_90d[-1].timestamp=2026-09-04T11:20 vs latest.timestamp=2026-09-04T13:20.
